parsed.answer: I found no past ticket reporting this problem: an OSC 52 clipboard write deadlocking Windows Terminal because EmptyClipboard runs while the reader thread holds the terminal write lock. The closest tickets are different problems. terminal#7994 is a hang from a user callback (hyperlink open) running under the terminal write lock, which was fixed by moving the call off the lock. It is the same class of bug but a different code path. terminal#2685, #2741, #3007 are older copy-to-clipboard crashes caused by clipboard access failures, fixed in 2019. terminal#17384 is a paste hang that turned out to come from WSL not reading its input. Treat this as a new report. Your analysis is solid and the proposed fix is sound: defer the WriteToClipboard raise to the dispatcher so it runs outside the lock, as the user-initiated copy path already does. Attach the symbolized minidump (~*k) to the ticket, since it will help maintainers confirm the lock holder. As a temporary workaround, set compatibility.allowOSC52 to false in settings, though that will stop claude code's copy-on-select from reaching the clipboard.
